BlackRock’s IBIT loses record $541M amid Anthropic market debut

stories.narrEn: Bloomberg reports: BlackRock Inc.’s spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund recorded its largest daily withdrawal as investors pulled money from the asset amid a broader selloff across risk assets. BeInCrypto reports: BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) lost $541.1 million on Nov. 19, the largest single-day outflow in the fund’s history. Cointelegraph reports: BlackRock’s IBIT posted its largest daily outflow on record, taking three-session outflows near $900 million as BTC dipped amid a broader market selloff. According to BeInCrypto, the selling is not spread evenly across the 12 exchange-traded funds (ETFs).
